vitest.why: A failing beforeAll: Jest fails every test in its describe; Vitest skips them. (Two of the three hooks here fail through done, which Vitest rejects outright.)

bun.why: A failing beforeAll in Bun: done(error) isn't treated as a failure, so that test passes; a beforeAll that throws or times out leaves its describe's tests out of the report, where Jest fails them.
